mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS id,a.depart_name AS name FROM "jeecg-boot-os".sys_depart a WHERE org_type = '1'
SELECT DISTINCT r.SECOND_CLASSIFY id, r.SECOND_CLASSIFY name FROM edw.fm_trs_guoku_base_table r WHERE r.FIRST_CLASSIFY = #{params.FIRST_CLASSIFY} and r.SECOND_CLASSIFY is not null
SELECT a.ID AS id,CONCAT(a.DATASOURCE_NAME,'(', a.TYPE,')') AS name FROM seo.seo_datasource a
SELECT b.ID AS id,b.DBNAME AS name,b.SCHEMA_NAME AS "SCHEMA_NAME" FROM seo.seo_datasource_database b WHERE b.SOURCE_ID = #{params.SOURCE_ID} AND b.STATE = '0'

select.if: SELECT TABLE_NAME AS id,TABLE_NAME AS name FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = #{params.DATABASE}
SELECT TABNAME AS id,TABNAME AS name FROM SYSCAT.TABLES WHERE TABSCHEMA = #{params.DATABASE}
SELECT name AS id,name AS name FROM system.tables WHERE database = #{params.DATABASE}
SELECT table_name AS id,table_name AS name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = #{params.SCHEMA_NAME} AND table_type IN ('BASE TABLE', 'VIEW')
SELECT table_name AS id,table_name AS name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = #{params.DATABASE} AND table_type IN ('BASE TABLE', 'VIEW')

SELECT TABLE_NAME AS "columnName",TABLE_COMMENT AS "columnComment" FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = #{params.DATABASE} AND TABLE_NAME = #{params.TABLE_SIGN} UNION SELECT COLUMN_NAME AS "columnName", CASE COLUMN_COMMENT WHEN NULL THEN COLUMN_NAME WHEN '' THEN COLUMN_NAME ELSE COLUMN_COMMENT END AS "columnComment" FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = #{params.DATABASE} AND TABLE_NAME = #{params.TABLE_SIGN}

SELECT TABNAME AS "columnName",REMARKS AS "columnComment" FROM SYSCAT.TABLES WHERE TABSCHEMA = #{params.DATABASE} AND TABNAME = #{params.TABLE_SIGN} UNION SELECT COLNAME AS "columnName", WHEN REMARKS IS NULL THEN COLNAME WHEN REMARKS = '' THEN COLNAME ELSE REMARKS END AS "columnComment" FROM SYSCAT. COLUMNS WHERE TABSCHEMA = #{params.DATABASE} AND TABNAME = #{params.TABLE_SIGN}

SELECT name AS "columnName",'' AS "columnComment" FROM system.tables WHERE database = #{params.DATABASE} AND name = #{params.TABLE_SIGN} UNION ALL SELECT name AS "columnName", CASE WHEN default_expression IS NULL THEN columnName WHEN default_expression = '' THEN columnName ELSE default_expression end AS "columnComment" FROM system.columns WHERE database = #{params.DATABASE} AND table = #{params.TABLE_SIGN}

SELECT c.relname AS "columnName",COALESCE(obj_description(c.oid), c.relname) AS "columnComment" FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = #{params.SCHEMA_NAME} AND c.relname = #{params.TABLE_SIGN} AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'v', 'm') UNION ALL SELECT a.attname AS "columnName",COALESCE(col_description(a.attrelid, a.attnum), a.attname) AS "columnComment" FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON a.attrelid = c.oid JOIN pg_namespace n ON c.relnamespace = n.oid WHERE n.nspname = #{params.SCHEMA_NAME} AND c.relname = #{params.TABLE_SIGN} AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped

SELECT c.relname AS "columnName",COALESCE(obj_description(c.oid), c.relname) AS "columnComment" FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = #{params.DATABASE} AND c.relname = #{params.TABLE_SIGN} AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'v', 'm') UNION ALL SELECT a.attname AS "columnName",COALESCE(col_description(a.attrelid, a.attnum), a.attname) AS "columnComment" FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON a.attrelid = c.oid JOIN pg_namespace n ON c.relnamespace = n.oid WHERE n.nspname = #{params.DATABASE} AND c.relname = #{params.TABLE_SIGN} AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped

mapper.select: SELECT a.ID AS "SOURE_ID", b.ID AS "DATABASE_ID", a.TYPE AS "TYPE", b.DBNAME AS "DBNAME", b.SCHEMA_NAME AS "SCHEMA_NAME", CASE WHEN a.TYPE = 'Vastbase' THEN b.SCHEMA_NAME ELSE b.DBNAME END AS "NAMESPACE" FROM seo.seo_datasource a LEFT JOIN seo.seo_datasource_database b ON a.ID = b.SOURCE_ID AND b.ID = #{params.DATABASE_ID} WHERE a.ID = #{params.SOURCE_ID}
